## Summary
Satyam Kumar Chaudhary (also known as Satyam Kumar, Satyam Chaudhary, or simply Satyam; online handles: codersatyam, sirsatyamchaudhary, satyam6290) is a 20-year-old full-stack web developer and DevOps engineer based in
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and
Engineering from AVIT (Aarupadai Veedu Institute of Technology), graduating in 2025.
He specialises in building scalable, production-ready web applications and cloud
infrastructure pipelines.
